instagramCampaign.welcomeMessage: Hi, I’m Archer, your restaurant campaign editor.
instagramCampaign.urlRequestMessage: Share a public restaurant Instagram profile, post, carousel, or Reel to begin.
instagramCampaign.brandReviewBody: Edit inferred details before anything is generated.
instagramCampaign.unverifiableTypographyCopy: No verifiable type specimen was accessible.
instagramCampaign.photographyFallback: Use only the approved source photography.
instagramCampaign.compositionFallback: Preserve the composition of approved source assets.
instagramCampaign.toneFallback: Use the restaurant’s approved event language.
instagramCampaign.eventBody: Plain language is fine. Archer asks only for missing essentials.
instagramCampaign.eventPlaceholder: Friday DJ night at the Marina venue, 9pm, table bookings open…
instagramCampaign.generateBody: Two 4:5 feed images and one 9:16 Story, using only approved restaurant assets and abstract graphic treatments.
instagramCampaign.imagePackSummary: Two 1080×1350 feed images and one 1080×1920 Story

sourceReview.heading: Choose the images Archer may use
sourceReview.permissionQuestion: Do you have permission to use {accountName}’s Instagram images, or should I use a different public account you own or manage?
sourceReview.body: Review the account identity and public evidence below. A guide or agency is not automatically a restaurant, and a profile picture is not automatically a logo.
sourceReview.permissionLabel: I have permission to use these selected images and any marks I selected for this campaign.
sourceReview.logoLabel: Use as a logo or visual mark
sourceReview.profileLabel: Profile picture, not an approved logo
sourceReview.altTextLabel: Image alt text, not a caption
sourceReview.languageNotice: Your approved images keep their original language. Changing the page language does not rewrite them.

limitations.login_wall: Instagram asked for sign-in. Archer stopped before opening restricted content.
limitations.private_content: Private content was not accessed. Only public evidence already available is included.
limitations.captcha: Instagram requested a security check. Archer stopped without solving it.
limitations.thumbnails_only: Only public thumbnails were available. Fine details and typography may be uncertain.
limitations.captions_unavailable: Post captions were unavailable. Alt text has not been treated as campaign copy.
limitations.media_unavailable: Some public images could not be retrieved and have been excluded.
limitations.time_limit: The bounded browsing session ended before deeper inspection was complete.

instagramCampaign.loginNotice: Sign in to turn the approved image into a six-second video, connect Instagram, schedule, or publish.
instagramCampaign.errorCopy: Archer could not complete this preview. Try another public Instagram URL.
instagramCampaign.invalidUrlError: Enter a full public Instagram profile, post, carousel, or Reel URL.
instagramCampaign.accessError: Instagram could not expose that public page. Try another public URL.
instagramCampaign.activePreviewError: Finish or restart the current Instagram campaign preview first.
instagramCampaign.limitError: The public preview limit has been reached. Sign in or try again later.
instagramCampaign.expiredError: This Instagram campaign preview expired. Start again.
instagramCampaign.validationError: Review the highlighted campaign details and try again.
instagramCampaign.generationError: The image pack could not be generated. Please try again.
instagramCampaign.claimError: Archer could not move this campaign into your private workspace. Please try again.
instagramCampaign.brandReadyMessage: I found the public brand signals. Review what was observed and what was inferred before we create anything.
instagramCampaign.brandApprovedMessage: Brand identity approved. Describe the event in plain language.
instagramCampaign.imagePackReadyMessage: Your three-image Instagram pack is ready to review and download.
instagramCampaign.imagesApprovedMessage: Images approved. Sign in to create a video, connect Instagram, schedule, or publish.
instagramCampaign.privateVideoOfferMessage: Your approved image pack is now private. Would you like a six-second 9:16 event promo, or would you prefer to finish with the image pack?

intake.title: Start with the restaurant's public Instagram
intake.body: Archer reads accessible brand signals, labels observations and inferences, and turns an approved event brief into three downloadable images.
intake.transferNote: Public assets only. Archer never bypasses private profiles, login walls, CAPTCHA, or unavailable media.

workflow.heading: Send real footage. Get the promo out before the event.
workflow.body: A three-step concierge workflow built around your team's calendar, brand rules, and approval chain.

steps.title: Send
steps.description: Share the real phone footage your venue team already captured.
details: Actual dishes, rooms, crowds, and events
One folder per venue or event

steps.title: Brand
steps.description: Archer cleans, edits, captions, and resizes without replacing what was filmed.

steps.title: Approve
steps.description: One named approver reviews a single link while Archer owns the clock.

delivery.heading: Four platform-native cuts. One deadline.
delivery.body: Each delivery is framed vertically, checked against the venue brand, and tied to the same event deadline.

guarantee.label: Deadline ownership
guarantee.heading: The clip is only useful before the event.
guarantee.body: Before editing starts, we agree the event deadline, named approver, delivery window, and revision window.

showcase.heading: This is the style.
showcase.body: AI-generated previews illustrating Archer's visual direction, not footage from an actual client or venue.
showcase.notice: These are illustrative style previews, not real pilot deliveries. Approved client work will replace them here once available.

features.heading: Capacity for every venue without replacing your editor.
features.body: Archer extends the production team around repeatable, deadline-sensitive promo work.

items.title: Brand consistency
items.body: Keep every venue's colors, type, end cards, captions, and tone in a reusable kit.

items.title: Approval turnaround
items.body: Route one consolidated review to one named approver instead of chasing a group chat.

items.title: Deadline ownership
items.body: Plan backward from doors open, with delivery and revision windows agreed before editing.

items.title: Platform resizing
items.body: Deliver deliberate 9:16 versions for Reels, TikTok, Shorts, and Snapchat.

items.title: Real footage only
items.body: Clean, edit, caption, and brand the footage you shot. Never synthesize the venue or event.

items.title: Editor capacity expansion
items.body: Absorb repeatable promo volume so your editor can protect higher-value creative work.

tracker.heading: Every venue, event, approval, and deadline in one view.
tracker.body: An operational tracker keeps the weekly production queue visible without pretending to be a live client dashboard.
tracker.sampleDisclaimer: Example workflow · not live client data

benefits.label: One weekly queue
benefits.body: See what arrived, what is moving, and what needs a decision.

benefits.label: One accountable approver
benefits.body: Make ownership visible before a deadline becomes a fire drill.

benefits.label: One delivery clock
benefits.body: Tie every platform cut to the event, not an open-ended content calendar.

meetArcher.heading: Meet Archer.
meetArcher.body: Archer takes repeatable event-promo editing off your team's critical path. Your editor keeps creative ownership. Archer adds the capacity, brand discipline, and deadline follow-through.

fit.heading: Who this is not for.
fit.body: Archer is designed for a specific operational problem, so the boundaries are as important as the promise.

items.label: Not for
items.title: Synthetic venue content
items.body: Archer does not invent dishes, rooms, crowds, performers, or events that were not captured.

items.label: Probably not for
items.title: Occasional single-location posting
items.body: A one-off post can use the editing demo, but it does not need the deadline-driven concierge service.

items.label: Built for
items.title: Multi-venue hospitality teams
items.body: Agencies and groups already collecting real footage across restaurants, bars, lounges, and nightlife venues.

pilot.heading: Prove the deadline workflow on real events.
pilot.body: Choose the venues and event calendar, name one approver, and agree delivery and revision windows before the first footage arrives.
pilot.secondaryPrompt: I want the one-post editing demo. I will share one of my existing Instagram posts for platform-native repurposing.
pilot.demoNote: The one-post demo shows editing capability. It is not the deadline-driven, multi-venue product experience.

steps.title: Choose the pilot venues
steps.body: Define the weekly event volume, brand kits, and platform mix.

steps.title: Name one approver
steps.body: Keep feedback consolidated and ownership clear.

steps.title: Agree the clock
steps.body: Set delivery and revision windows around real event deadlines.

footer.tagline: Real hospitality footage, branded and delivered before the event deadline.

presentationMedia.notice: Cinematic visuals are decorative, not client footage or pilot deliverables.

roiCalculator.heading: Model the production economics of Archer
roiCalculator.subheading: Treat freelance editor days you stop paying as cost elimination, and in-house hours as capacity you can reallocate.
roiCalculator.disclaimer: Figures are modeled estimates from your assumptions. Returned hours are capacity, not an automatic payroll saving, and are not observed customer results.
roiCalculator.economicsNote: All-in operating cost is model tokens, tools, and the platform licence, not a salary comparison.
roiCalculator.allocationHelp: Hours removed are capacity. Only the shares you assign to cost reduction, extra volume, or higher-value work are given a euro value.

negativeProductivity.heading: Negative productivity removed
negativeProductivity.body: Repetitive cut-downs, caption variants, and format churn that consume editor days without creating new footage.

positiveProductivity.heading: Potential positive productivity
positiveProductivity.body: Returned production time can take more events, or stop paying overflow editors.
items: More events in the same week
